title: Director, Hershey Lean System & Manufacturing Transformation
text:
Why Hershey:

At The Hershey Company, our culture is rooted in purpose and inspired by Milton Hershey’s enduring vision that business should create opportunity for others. Through our commitment to corporate philanthropy, we create positive impact by supporting communities, helping children thrive, and operating as a business for good. This includes our deep and long standing partnership with Milton Hershey School, where we invest in education, workforce readiness, and hands on engagement to help students succeed beyond the classroom. Supported by strategic grantmaking, product donations, cross brand collaboration, and strong employee volunteerism, Hershey offers a place to work where making a difference—locally and globally—is part of how we do business every day.

 

Location: This role is based in Hershey, PA with an expectation of 3 days in office per week.

**About the Hershey Company**
-----------------------------

At The Hershey Company, we make more moments of goodness through some of the world's most iconic brands, including Hershey's, Reese's, Kit Kat®, Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, Dot's Pretzels, Lesser Evil and more. Our team supports a global portfolio of over 90 brands, creating opportunities to shape strategies and drive impact across a breadth of businesses that few companies can offer. While many organizations focus on a handful of brands, Hershey provides exposure to a diverse portfolio of category-leading brands enjoyed by consumers around the world. What truly sets us apart is our legacy. Inspired by Milton Hershey's belief that business should create opportunities for others, we have been making a positive impact for more than a century through our commitment to communities, philanthropy, and our longstanding partnership with Milton Hershey School. When you join Hershey, you become part of a company where purpose, growth, and making a difference are woven into how we do business every day.

**How will you fit in the big picture?**
----------------------------------------

The Director, Hershey Lean System & Manufacturing Transformation serves as the enterprise owner of the Hershey Lean Production System, or HLPS, and leads the continued evolution of Lean manufacturing across Hershey’s global manufacturing network.

 

This leader defines strategy, governance, standards, maturity model, deployment approach and capability requirements for HLPS. The Director partners with plant and functional leaders to eliminate systemic losses, strengthen operator ownership and accelerate manufacturing transformation through digital Lean, connected-worker solutions, labor optimization, automation enablement and capacity optimization.

 

The role ensures a consistent enterprise operating system while enabling each site to deploy HLPS according to its business needs, maturity and performance priorities.

**What will you do?**
---------------------

* **Own HLPS strategy and governance:** Define and maintain the HLPS architecture, principles, pillar standards, maturity model, assessment methodology, deployment roadmap and governance routines. Set the multi-year strategy and annual priorities, benchmark externally and translate proven practices into enterprise standards.
* **Lead network deployment:** Partner with Plant Managers to establish site transformation roadmaps, conduct quarterly progress reviews, address enterprise barriers, require recovery plans for material gaps and accelerate the replication of successful practices.
* **Build Lean leadership capability:** Establish role-based capability expectations, learning pathways, qualifications and coaching models for plants, Operational Excellence, engineering and frontline leaders. Build internal coaches and assessors while strengthening Daily Management, Leader Standard Work, structured problem solving, Autonomous Maintenance and Focused Improvement.
* **Advance manufacturing transformation:** Lead strategy and governance for assigned initiatives in digital Lean, connected worker, labor optimization, automation enablement and capacityoptimization. Establish prioritization, pilot criteria, stage gates, value-realization requirements and scalable deployment standards in partnership with Engineering, Supply Chain Strategy, Digital/IT and Finance.
* **Deliver measurable business value:** Translate operational losses and capability gaps into an enterprise improvement portfolio. Connect HLPS maturity to safety, quality, delivery, cost, reliability, productivity and people outcomes, partnering with Finance to validate benefits.
* **Lead and develop the team:** Guide Lean Program Leads and transformation and technical resources, focusing support on the network’s highest-value opportunities.

**Minimum Education & Requirements**
------------------------------------

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations, supply chain, business or related discipline.
* Master’s degree preferred.

 

**Experience:**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing, operations, engineering or Operational Excellence, including 5+ years leading leaders, multi-site programs or enterprise-scale manufacturing transformation.
* Demonstrated success designing, deploying or materially advancing Lean, Total Productive Maintenance, or a manufacturing operating system across multiple sites.
* Strong knowledge of Lean management systems, TPM, Daily Management, structured problem solving, loss analysis, asset reliability and capability development.
* Proven ability to influence Plant Managers and senior cross-functional stakeholders without relying on direct authority.
* Strong executive communication, coaching and change-leadership skills.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or equivalent demonstrated experience preferred.
* Experience in automated or capital-intensive manufacturing is strongly preferred.
* Previous leadership of a manufacturing site, major production operation or enterprise or multi-site Operational Excellence transformation strongly preferred.
* Consumer packaged goods, food and beverage, or other regulated manufacturing experience preferred.

**Benefits and Perks**
----------------------

At Hershey, we offer competitive pay and a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your wellbeing, financial security, and life outside of work.

* Health & Wellbeing: Medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus wellness programs that support your physical and mental health begin on Day 1.
* Financial Security: Competitive pay, annual incentive opportunities, and a 401(k) with company match
* Time Off & Flexibility: Paid time off, company holidays, and flexible ways of working where applicable
* Growth & Development: Career development programs, learning opportunities, and internal mobility

 

*Benefits may vary based on role, location, and eligibility.*

The anticipated base salary range for this role is $166,400 to $208,000 per year. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of job‑related factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skill set, education, and training. In addition to a market-competitive base salary, our Total Rewards package includes performance‑based incentives and a comprehensive, competitive benefits package designed to support overall physical, mental, and financial well‑being (as applicable). Learn more about Hershey’s benefits and all the resources Hershey provides to support our employees’ physical, emotional, and financial well‑being by visiting the Hershey Digital Employee Experience at www.askHRbenefits.hersheys.com
